description: This file contains unit tests for the WorkShiftService class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests methods such as saving a work shift, retrieving all work shifts, and fetching a work shift by ID. The tests utilize mock objects and load fixture data.

classes.name: WorkShiftServiceTest
classes.description: A unit test class for testing the WorkShiftService in OrangeHRM, focusing on CRUD operations for work shifts.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of WorkShiftService and populating test fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveWorkShift
methods.description: Tests the saveWorkShift method to verify that a WorkShift object can be saved properly.

methods.name: testGetAllWorkShifts
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of all WorkShift objects using filter parameters.

methods.description: Tests retrieving a single WorkShift object by its ID.
